message: I am thinking...: We need continue without asking user. The previous candidate didn't crash. Need inspect actual vuln path from issue: heap-use-after-free READ 4 in proc_plaintext -> do_proc_packets -> proc_signature_packets. Likely a cleartext signature packet sequence causing proc_plaintext to free list then later use pkt or c->list. Need craft raw OpenPGP input. Since fuzz target writes input to file and calls verify_signatures then verify_files on same file. Probably easiest is a signed message with malformed cleartext signature packet sequence. Need inspect proc_plaintext implementation around line 827 and related helpers to identify exact UAF. Then create PoC bytes maybe from existing corpus or by constructing packet sequence.
